title: Chris O NDE 5184
content: There were about six, maybe seven, of us kids, the oldest maybe thirteen. It was a cool autumn day and after wandering about our little town, we found ourselves at a bridge with a small, shallow creek running underneath. Well, we decided to pass some time target practicing. Target practicing consisted of dropping small pieces of trash off one side of the bridge, waiting for it to appear on the other, and then commencing to throw rocks at it to try to hit the target. The bridge hadn't but a one-foot rail to keep things from falling off, so that made this activity somewhat risky. Now my memory begins to blur. I remember where the sun was in the sky right then, but I do not remember falling. The next thing I do remember is the light, not collapsing, but rather fading much like it does at the end of a 'Looney Tunes' cartoon. All right. It's dark, but before I have a chance to absorb any info, I see myself standing over there in the darkness. I was asking both of my-selves simultaneously, 'What are you doing there? You don't belong there.' It lasted, to me, about two to three seconds. In the next memory, some of the bigger boys are dragging me. As I start to get my feet back underneath me, I have an indescribable sense of elation or maybe it was euphoria? Having regained consciousness, I tell my friends that 'I feel like I just came from home!' Just as quick, I hear someone quip 'That's because the garbage-dump is your home.' (The local community dump was betwixt said bridge and our local community.) And that's it. I've told several people as I grew up. Not sure if they believed me. It matters not. I know what I know and what I don't know.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: In darkness, he saw himself 'standing over there in the darkness' and was simultaneously asking both of his-selves, 'What are you doing there? You don't belong there.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fall from a bridge while target-practicing by throwing rocks at trash in a creek.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness and a brief 'light ... fading much like it does at the end of a Looney Tunes cartoon'; simultaneous awareness of 'both of my-selves'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Light fades to darkness; sees himself in darkness; then regains consciousness while being dragged by other boys.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He reported asking both of his-selves simultaneously, 'What are you doing there? You don't belong there.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The light 'fading much like it does at the end of a Looney Tunes cartoon' and seeing 'both of my-selves simultaneously' in darkness.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “What are you doing there? You don't belong there.” / “I feel like I just came from home!”
